description: Liu Yao (六爻) divination for one question: six lines by coin toss (default), by time or given manually; original and changed hexagram, six relatives, use god. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the user's language without changing the judgement. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.05 per cast.

mode.description: coin (default): the server tosses three coins six times; time: derived from the moment; manual: pass `values`

options.description: School / rule options as { group: id }; defaults match mingge.org. See list_options for groups and ids.

topic.description: What the question is about: wealth_seek money, career_promo promotion, job_seek job hunt, love_can will this romance work, marriage, partnership business partner, waiting_news news, waiting_person someone's arrival, travel, lost_item, lawsuit, illness, other. Also exam, property, family.

tz.description: Asker's IANA time zone; alone = cast for this moment

values.description: manual mode: six line values bottom to top, 6 old yin, 7 young yang, 8 young yin, 9 old yang

variant.description: Required for some topics — lost_item: valuables|documents|belongings|animal|person; love_can / marriage: target_male|target_female (who is being asked about); illness: patient_self|patient_other; family: kin_parent|kin_child|kin_sibling
